scenario: Retail store: smart lighting VLAN separate from the till PCs.
prompt: We're fitting a small retail shop. There'll be four till PCs and about six network-controlled LED light units. Keep the shop lighting on its own network, away from the till PCs, and wire the lights in. Ordinary DSL internet is fine.

requirements.statement: Shop lighting is on its own network, separate from the till PCs
The light units are wired in

expected_behaviour: Till VLAN + IoT VLAN declaration, 6 cabled smart_led things, DSL internet. The 'shop lighting on its own network, separate from the till PCs' clause verifies UNKNOWN — IoT things are created and cabled with no IP/VLAN placement (expander _place_iot, CG-2), so they do not land on a separately verified segment.
why_valuable: Second IoT case with a different domain (retail tills) and a different internet shape (DSL) from oc-011, so it carries distinct discriminating power rather than restating the office case.
